beat the inferior miami dolphins but the 15 10 final score paints an accurate picture of the afternoon 39 s peculiarity as does the camera operator 39 s decision to focus on reichard of all vikings players the kicker mattered vitally to sunday 39 s outcome reichard made all five of his field goal attempts on an even deeper level he occupies a central role in the story of a season that will become more of a fixture in the national discussion after four games the vikings are one of only three remaining undefeated teams alongside the san francisco 49ers and kansas city chiefs adding an idiosyncratic profile to a mix featuring two offensive behemoths unlike san francisco and kansas city you cannot explain minnesota 39 s start by praising a hyper efficient quarterback or gushing over a field tilting running back for the vikings it takes dissecting a third year kicker 39 s special teams unit and brian flores 39 suffocating defense 34 again the defense was holding it down for us 34 quarterback kyler murray said 34 they went out there and did it again 34 reichard hasn 39 t missed since last october his 31 straight streak is the longest of any active nfl kicker meanwhile the vikings 39 defensive performance through four weeks ranks among the best defenses since the turn of the century according to many of the most respected advanced metrics toss in the explosive output of second year returner myles price and even exceptional special teams play from youngsters like zemaiah vaughn who blasted dolphins returner malik washington on sunday and this absurd beginning to the 2026 season makes more sense sustainability and potential hinge on offensive growth something both head coach kevin o 39 connell and murray acknowledge tight end t j hockenson 39 s decision to go down to ice the game in the fourth quarter serves as critical context to this nugget but the vikings 39 six total offensive touchdowns are tied for the fewest scored by any team during a 4 0 start this century according to trumedia matching both the 2003 carolina panthers and 2016 vikings 34 we 39 ve got to keep working at it offensively 34 o 39 connell said 34 and we can 39 t accept any aspect of this that wasn 39 t a really good play by the defense we 39 ve got to own our role in our own aspect of not moving the football more consistently and go from there 34 before reichard unknowingly earned a chorus of cheers a disturbed crowd booed intermittently dolphins sacks generated groans penalties produced a collective grumble the cauldron of stress built over multiple games showed in sideline gesticulations from offensive coaches the vikings were without superstar receiver justin jefferson who missed sunday 39 s game with an ankle injury they also lost two starting offensive linemen in the game left tackle christian darrisaw and left guard donovan jackson but those absences don 39 t excuse an offensive day that didn 39 t lift the team 39 s league worst average in yards per play on his first snap murray progressed too quickly off of hockenson and took a sack back to back pre snap infractions doomed the second drive most of the first half felt like an answer in example form to someone asking what does it mean to take one step forward and two steps back an illegal formation followed a perfectly placed comeback route to receiver jordan addison a false start followed a 15 yard third down conversion to running back aaron jones in total the vikings committed eight offensive penalties the only time they have had more in a game under o 39 connell was in week 10 last season versus the baltimore ravens pre snap complications affected third down distance and minnesota 39 s effectiveness on third downs changed drastically depending on that distance the vikings converted 6 of 7 third and short opportunities they finished 0 for 7 in third and long instances 34 to be honest with you the only thing that hurt us was ourselves in certain situations 34 hockenson said 34 when we are able to play our game we 39 re moving the ball then you get behind the sticks and you 39 re fighting to get back on track 34 o 39 connell mentioned cadence miscommunications as one issue using a new personnel grouping may have been another factor for the first time the vikings also toyed with jumbo sets utilizing rookie tackle caleb tiernan as an extra offensive lineman murray owned the disjointedness in his postgame presser opting not to paper over the problems 34 i 39 ve been a part of this a long time now 34 murray said 34 that door will get kicked down soon there 39 s no loss of confidence in that room we 39 ve got to be better and cleaner and we will be 34 it would be more difficult to believe these words if glimmers didn 39 t surface in the fourth quarter murray checked the ball down in rhythm to jones he hung in the pocket and manipulated dolphins linebacker jordyn brooks with his eyes finding addison for an intermediate gain most notably murray established a rapport with hockenson who caught all 13 of his targets for 119 yards this connection feasted against split safety coverage because miami worked so hard to keep two safeties deep hockenson chiseled away in the middle of the field in many ways this was part of the vikings 39 initial vision jefferson and addison 39 s gravity would create interior space for an improved run game murray 39 s own legs and hockenson scalpel the interior and defenses would then have to choose where to allocate bodies murray 39 s fourth quarter accuracy brought some of this strategy to life high leverage completions stacked atop reichard 39 s precision and the defense 39 s ability to limit dolphins quarterback malik willis to just 85 yards on 9 of 17 passing provided a sensible roadmap for more success 34 i did think kyler got better as the game went on 34 o 39 connell said 34 he was more comfortable there were some big time throws there to keep the ball away from the dolphins and drive it both times for yards 34 these flashes supply oxygen to an offense that knows its current formula cannot sustain more than anything else they offer hope that this early season record won 39 t be remembered as an aberration but instead as fuel for the team 39 s further ascent this article originally appeared in the athletic
